title: Money & currency
body:
Currency is the Japanese yen (¥). Tokyo is more card-friendly than its reputation, but small izakaya, ramen ticket machines, and some traditional spots remain cash- or IC-card-only — carry cash as backup.

Seven Bank (7-Eleven) ATMs are the most reliable for foreign cards: 24/7, 28,000+ locations nationwide, and they accept Visa/Plus, Mastercard/Maestro/Cirrus, UnionPay, Amex, JCB, Discover and Diners Club. Per-withdrawal limit is {{fact:atm-withdrawal-limit-100000-yen}}.

Tax-free shopping still runs on the old instant-discount system for this trip — Japan's switch to a refund-at-departure system starts {{fact:tax-free-refund-switch-nov-1-2026}}, after you've left.

title: Budget & daily costs
intro: Per-person estimates for a food-focused trip. Casual food and local transport are aggregator-sourced ranges (⚠ not a single official figure); the two booked dinners are the venues' own published prices plus their service charges, and each is its own line rather than folded into a daily average. Lodging is left at zero — accommodation style wasn't set at intake.

items.label: Lodging, whole trip
items.note: Not researched — accommodation style wasn't specified at intake.

items.label: Food & drink — casual meals, 4 days (Fri, Sun, Mon, Tue)
items.note: ≈¥5,000–9,000 a day across the four non-anchor days, aggregator-sourced. On a trip basis rather than a daily one because Saturday's food is the anchor-dinner line below, not a casual day — a per-day figure would be multiplied across all five days and count Saturday twice.

items.label: Saturday anchor dinner (RyuGin), per person
items.note: {{fact:ryugin-course-88550-yen}}. The low figure is the same ¥77,000 course at a table seat, where the service charge is 10% rather than 15%.

items.label: Monday dinner (Yakiniku Ushigoro), per person
items.note: Courses ¥16,000–32,000 tax included, plus a 10% service charge. The mid figure assumes one of the two lower courses.

items.label: Local transport, per day
items.note: IC-card tap fares on JR/Metro/Toei scale ¥155–¥616 per ride; figure assumes a few rides a day, not an all-day pass.

items.label: Sights & activities, per day
items.note: Light-touch sights budget: Shinjuku Gyoen ¥500, Tokyo Tower ¥1,200–1,500, teamLab Planets ≈¥3,800–4,200 (⚠ teamlab.art publishes its prices only on a live ticket page — confirm before booking). Spread across the trip, not a paid stop every day.

items.label: Flights — round trip
items.note: Not researched — departure airport wasn't confirmed at intake.
